name: Okta SAML App Provisioning – Workato Recipe
description: Automated recipe that provisions SAML 2.0 apps in Okta with multi-tenant routing, manager approval for production, and full SAML configuration support.

trigger.name: New SAML provisioning request
trigger.description: Triggered by an incoming webhook (e.g. from a ServiceNow ticket, Jira issue, or Slack command) requesting SAML app setup.

expected_payload.tenant: string (required) – which Okta tenant to target: 'production', 'preview', or 'development'
expected_payload.app_label: string (required) – display name of the app in Okta
expected_payload.audience_uri: string (required) – SP Entity ID / Audience URI
expected_payload.requestor_email: string (required) – email of the person requesting
groups: string – Okta group names to assign
expected_payload.name_id_format: string (optional) – NameID format, defaults to emailAddress
expected_payload.name_id_value: string (optional) – Okta attribute for NameID, defaults to user.email
expected_payload.response_signed: boolean (optional) – sign SAML response, defaults to true
expected_payload.assertion_signed: boolean (optional) – sign SAML assertion, defaults to true
expected_payload.signature_algorithm: string (optional) – RSA-SHA256 or RSA-SHA1, defaults to RSA-SHA256
expected_payload.digest_algorithm: string (optional) – SHA256 or SHA1, defaults to SHA256

attribute_statements.name: string – attribute name as SP expects it
values: string – Okta user profile expression (e.g. user.email)

actions.name: Validate required fields
actions.condition: {{trigger.tenant}} is present AND {{trigger.app_label}} is present AND {{trigger.sso_acs_url}} is present AND {{trigger.audience_uri}} is present AND {{trigger.requestor_email}} is present

if_false.error_message: Missing required fields. Payload must include: tenant, app_label, sso_acs_url, audience_uri, requestor_email.

actions.name: Resolve Okta tenant connection
actions.description: Maps the tenant name from the webhook to the correct Okta connection and determines whether approval is required.

on_miss.error_message: Unknown tenant '{{trigger.tenant}}'. Must be one of: production, preview, development.

actions.name: Require approval for production
actions.description: If targeting production, pause and request manager approval before making any changes.

input.message:
:warning: *Approval required* — SAML app provisioning to *{{tenant_config.label}}*

App: *{{trigger.app_label}}*
ACS URL: `{{trigger.sso_acs_url}}`
Audience URI: `{{trigger.audience_uri}}`
Requested by: {{trigger.requestor_email}}
Groups: {{trigger.groups | join: ', '}}

React with :white_check_mark: to approve or :x: to deny.

input.subject: SAML provisioning denied for {{trigger.app_label}}
input.body:
Hi,

Your request to provision the SAML application "{{trigger.app_label}}" in the {{tenant_config.label}} Okta tenant was denied.

Please contact the Identity team for more details.

Thanks,
Identity Automation (Workato)

actions.name: Update existing SAML application
actions.description: Only runs if step 5 found an existing app.

if_false.message: [{{tenant_config.label}}] Group '{{group_name}}' not found in Okta – skipping.

input.subject: [{{tenant_config.label}}] SAML SSO configured for {{trigger.app_label}}
input.body:
Hi,

Your SAML application "{{trigger.app_label}}" has been configured in the {{tenant_config.label}} Okta tenant.

Tenant:  {{tenant_config.label}} ({{tenant_config.org_url}})
App ID:  {{configured_app.id}}
SSO URL: {{configured_app.settings.signOn.ssoAcsUrl}}

The IdP metadata XML is attached. Upload it to your service provider to complete the SSO setup.

Thanks,
Identity Automation (Workato)

okta_connection_prod.notes: Production Okta connection. Requires an API token with Application Administrator privileges. Configure in Workato UI: App Connections > Okta.

okta_connection_preview.notes: Preview/staging Okta connection. Configure in Workato UI: App Connections > Okta.

okta_connection_dev.notes: Development sandbox Okta connection. Configure in Workato UI: App Connections > Okta.

smtp_connection.notes: Email provider for sending metadata to requestors. Configure in Workato UI: App Connections > SMTP.

slack_connection.notes: Slack bot for #identity-ops notifications and production approval prompts. Needs posting + reactions permissions.
